newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-BARCELONA ROLL OVER KINDER BOLOGNA 103-92.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BARCELONA ROLL OVER KINDER BOLOGNA 103-92.

text.p: Barcelona got a key win on Thursday when they dismissed Italy's Kinder Bologna 103-92 in their EuroLeague Group H match.
Barcelona, who beat front-running Istanbul's Efes Pilsen 69-67 last month to keep their EuroLeague hopes alive, moved into third place on 21 points, four behind the Turkish side.
They had no trouble against injury-riddled Bologna, soaring to a 58-43 lead by the 22nd minute of the secondhalf despite an unusually low 15 points from Serbian marksman Aleksandar Djordjevic.
Arijan Komacez scored a game-high 39 points for the Italians, although most came in the final minutes when Bologna's cause was already lost.

The Italians are even with Croatia's Split on 20 points and can still qualify for the last 16. Their next match is against bottom club Bayer Lerverkusen while Barcelona, last year's beaten finalists, meet Partizan Belgrade, who are second on 22 points.

There was disappointment in Group F for Ulker Spor of Turkey who lost 82-81 after overtime to Cibona Zagreb and now have no hope of making the last 16 with their 4-10 record from 14 games. Two group matches remain before the remaining clubs move on to the knock-out stage.
